normative_and_research_context.label_status: WaterSense specification sunset effective 2019-01-01; do not claim current WaterSense label
normative_and_research_context.interpretation_limit: U.S. regulatory reference only; not a South African compliance rule or a completed-task outcome.

normative_and_research_context.jurisdiction: International standard method; applicability determined by user/jurisdiction
normative_and_research_context.interpretation_limit: Valve-level method is not a substitute for a matched task-level soil-removal protocol; full standard text is separately controlled.
Use as a comparator test envelope, then confirm target product and market requirements.

caveats: Values are manufacturer-published and have not been independently measured by this programme.
Published force at 60 psi does not establish force across an installation's full operating envelope.
Certification listings must be verified against the current exact model/revision and intended installation.

legacy_high_flow_context.interpretation_limit: Context only; not a claim that every legacy product operates in this range.

guardrails: same predeclared soil/load and removal endpoint
spray force remains adequate and within declared target range across pressure conditions
coverage failures cannot be hidden by aggregate spray force
operator time and effort reported separately
product wear and post-service repeat tests included

design_notes: Three specimens is an initial engineering target, not a statistical sufficiency guarantee; increase sample size after a repeatability/power assessment.
Measure flowing pressure, flow, force, spatial coverage, total water to task completion, trigger-on time, residual soil, splash deposition and operator effort.
Use the same fixture, nozzle-to-target distance, angle, water temperature, soil recipe, substrate and endpoint for candidate/reference pairs.
Randomize or balance product order and preserve every invalid, failed and rerinse trial.
Re-test after a declared endurance/wear cycle and after every repair.

comparison_rules: Do not compare data-sheet flow alone as task-level efficiency.
Do not treat published force at one pressure as a measured pressure-response curve.
Report both valve-level ASTM-style metrics and independent task-level outcomes.
Never pool household sink/faucet data with commercial pre-rinse results.
No certification, hygiene, microbial reduction or superiority claim from this catalogue.
